name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.
texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent must be holding the box on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box at that moment.
machine:

STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3, u4
INITIAL_STATE: u0

DEFAULT_REWARD: 0

(u0, !at_exit&box_fell) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u1

(u1, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u1, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u0
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u3
(u2, box_fell&holding_box) -> u1
(u3, !box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u3, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u0
(u3, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u3, box_fell&holding_box) -> u1

(u0, !at_exit&box_fell, u1) -> -1

(u1, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box, u4) -> -10
